title: BACKYARD / SMOKER ON THE BALCONY barks whirling

dialogueTree.speaker: Smoker on the Balcony -> N/A
dialogueTree.english: "I'm practically a shrink minus the diploma."

dialogueTree.speaker: Smoker on the Balcony -> N/A
dialogueTree.english: "*How* can a bar be out of vermouth?"

dialogueTree.speaker: Smoker on the Balcony -> N/A
dialogueTree.english: "Can't do it with class? Don't do it at all."
dialogueTree.polish: „Nie możesz zrobić czegoś z klasą? To nie rób tego wcale”.
dialogueTree.belarusian: "Не можаш зрабіць з класам? Не рабі зусім."

dialogueTree.speaker: Smoker on the Balcony -> N/A
dialogueTree.english: "Could I get a refill here, please?"

dialogueTree.speaker: Smoker on the Balcony -> N/A
dialogueTree.english: "Don't even get me started on beauty..."

dialogueTree.speaker: Smoker on the Balcony -> N/A
dialogueTree.english: "Yes, yes, I'm very attractive. Great, thank you."
dialogueTree.polish: „Tak, tak. Jestem bardzo atrakcyjny. Świetnie, dziękuję”.
dialogueTree.belarusian: "Так, так, я вельмі прывабны. Выдатна, дзякуй."

dialogueTree.speaker: Smoker on the Balcony -> N/A
dialogueTree.english: "Okay, *you* tell me this doesn't taste like shit..."
dialogueTree.polish: „No dobra, spróbuj tego i *powiedz* mi, że nie smakuje jak gówno...”
dialogueTree.belarusian: "Добра, *ты* скажы мне, што гэта на смак не як лайно..."
